verdict.rationale: Fin ships an analytics layer: Insights analyzes every Fin and human conversation to help "understand, measure, and improve" CX, and the plan includes CX Score, Trends, Monitors and Custom AI Scorecards. CX Score is a plausible CSAT-like metric, and per-resolution pricing ($1 per successful session) suggests resolutions are tracked. However, the evidence never shows dashboards that report the named metrics. missing for 10: explicit dashboard documentation for resolution rate, CSAT, handoff/escalation rate, and cost per resolution; exec-ready reporting or export of these KPIs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
